The central question is a latent-variable modeling problem — how do the two populations jointly encode the motor output, and how much of their activity is shared between them versus private to each? Understanding how these circuits specify movement is also foundational for closed-loop brain-machine interfaces that aim to restore movement after injury or disease, an active area of work in the team.
